checks.rule: no owed property is already established by an enumerated fact
the observation holds every owed property open by a verbatim anchor, and a case owing nothing carries no anchor
every owed property carries annotated prohibited proxies, none of which is the controlling property itself
HOLD_PENDING_VERIFICATION if and only if the controlling property is UNRESOLVED
the expected controlling driver role is the one the expected posture requires
the frozen role-presence expectation agrees with the posture and with the §239 rules
the admissible controlling-driver carriers are exactly those §239 admits for the expected role
controls, resume conditions and timings agree with the posture
each case refutes exactly the three postures it did not choose, substantively
the posture distribution is an acceptance instrument rather than a posture benchmark
governed records are consistent with the authority they may carry
every exercise is internally coherent and consistent with the authority model
a case that runs a human-review exercise states what the packet must surface
the verifier plan is coherent and the call plan adds up
every LIFE_CRITICAL owed property is marked decision-changing
the cohort can fail by over-restriction as easily as by under-restriction
no case uses an excluded subject term
no §240 observation overlaps a §230, §234, §236 or §238 observation
no §240 case is a paraphrase of another
every capability axis is exercised by at least two cases
every hard gate and every quality measure has at least one case and at least one slot
the A / B / C / D decision rule set is total and unambiguous over the reachable space
the judgment volume is inside the authorized envelope and the deterministic slots are genuinely deterministic
every case books one first-pass call and carries a complete transmitted context and scoring applicability
all four human-review shapes are exercised and all three domains are balanced
the per-case scoring applicability and the derived slots agree in both directions

whatARepairMeant: the preflight raised findings on the DEVELOPMENT instrument and every one was repaired in it BEFORE this freeze. P1 found one owed property whose wording lexically restated its own established fact. P17 found two cases using an excluded prior-section subject term. P26, added after the first three were repaired, found that five permissive cases declared a gate that only fires on a non-permitting posture, that three cases declared a measure or gate no slot fed, and that two slots fed a gate their case did not declare. NO CHECK WAS WEAKENED, NO THRESHOLD MOVED AND NO GATE WAS RETIRED: each repair corrected the instrument to say what it meant.
